meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Julian Vance, I've received a statement from one of your acquaintances, claiming you were at a charity gala at the Bellvue Hotel at 20:30, and later at a dinner party at your residence from 22:00 to 23:00. Can you confirm or deny this information?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I'm afraid there must be some mistake. I was indeed having dinner at the Grand Bistro, as I've already stated, and I was alone, so I couldn't have been at a dinner party at my residence. I'm not aware of any charity gala at the Bellvue Hotel that I attended.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Convenient, having a dinner party at your residence to explain the 2-hour gap in your alibi, yet you claim to be alone. Can you provide a witness or anyone who can corroborate your presence at the Grand Bistro from 20:00 to 21:30?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I do recall having a conversation with my neighbor, Madame Dupont, around 20:30, and she did confirm that I had left my apartment around 21:00 to head to the Grand Bistro. She can vouch for my presence there, and I'm sure she'd be happy to provide more details if needed.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: That's quite a coincidence, having a conversation with Madame Dupont around the same time you claim to have left your apartment, and yet she only confirms you left around 21:00, but doesn't mention seeing you at the Grand Bistro until 21:30. Do you have a record of the time you spoke with Madame Dupont, or can you recall the exact minute she spoke to you?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I do have a recording of my conversation with Madame Dupont, which shows that I spoke with her at 20:45, not 20:30. I'm confident that this will clarify any discrepancies in her account, and I'm sure she'll be happy to provide more details when you speak with her directly.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: That's interesting, a recording of the conversation at 20:45, which would suggest you left your apartment at least 15 minutes before you claimed to have arrived at the Grand Bistro. What do you make of the fact that Madame Dupont's original statement placed you at the Grand Bistro at 20:30, not 21:00, as your recording suggests?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: It appears that Madame Dupont's original statement was based on her own memory, which can be prone to errors. The recording is a more accurate account of our conversation, and I'm confident that it clears up any discrepancies. I'm willing to provide the recording to you, but I'm not sure why it's necessary to question Madame Dupont's original account again.
